Example Manufacturing Ltd (fictional) - overview:
Products: precision-machined parts, steel structures and custom fasteners for construction, energy and engineering. Founded in 2012 by two engineers; moved to modern facilities in 2018, with 20 employees, CNC machining and robotic welding. Two key employees acquired minority stakes in 2020. Revenue: EUR 3.5 million. Strengths: delivery reliability, quality and customer collaboration. Primarily domestic sales, with initial Nordic expansion and a goal of joining international supply chains.
